item.title: ‘TO MISS A GAME, THAT SUCKS,’ TRUSTY’S TAKE ON BAN
item.description: IT’S been a strange few days in the life of Celtic centre-back Auston Trusty. Hailed as a goal hero in back-to-back Europa League encounters against Bologna and FC Utrecht, the USA World Cup Finals-bound defender saw red in last weekend’s 2-2 Premiership stalemate against Hearts at Tynecastle. item.title: GREEN LIGHT FOR JUNIOR?
item.description: CELTIC are working on a frantic beat-the-clock loan deal for SC Freiburg forward Junior Adamu. The 24-year-old Austrian international forward is awaiting the green light to travel to Scotland to complete the signing formalities, according to Sky Sports Germany.
